cli_agent.title: Connect a CLI agent
cli_agent.not_installed: No connected server can run a CLI harness. Install the CLI Agent connector from the marketplace first.
cli_agent.offline_hint: The connector is not running, so the host cannot be scanned. Start it from the MCP servers screen.
cli_agent.none_found: The connector ran but found no harness on this host.
cli_agent.metered_warning: This harness is set up with an API key, so runs are billed per token rather than covered by a subscription.
cli_agent.no_bound_agents: No agent currently uses this connector as its reasoning engine.
cli_agent.binding_note: These settings apply to this agent's next run without restarting the connector.
cli_agent.binding_invalid: Could not read this agent's saved run settings
cli_agent.agent_missing: The selected agent no longer exists
cli_agent.restart_note: Saving restarts the connector: these options are read when its process starts.
cli_agent.probe_failed: Could not read the harnesses on this host
cli_agent.save_failed: Could not save the connection options

ask.run_why: "Go ahead" lets me run {{name}} from now on without asking. "Just this once" is for this request only.
ask.run_why_several: "Go ahead" lets me run these {{count}} commands from now on without asking. "Just this once" is for this request only.
ask.rejected: I tried to use {{tool}}, and it was refused.
ask.rejected_hard: This cannot be changed from the settings.

roster.note: The display name and the avatar are changed from “Open settings”. Nothing is applied until you save.

create.description_sub: The role, the manner, what you want done. This is where the character is decided.
create.password_sub: Optional. Asked for before this agent is stopped or deleted.
create.routing_sub: Optional. Send a turn to another engine when it matches.

settings.description_sub: The role, the manner, what you want done. This is where the character is decided.
settings.password_sub: Optional. Asked for before this agent is stopped or deleted.
settings.password_unchanged: Leave empty to keep the current one
settings.password_hint: With one set, you are asked for it when you stop this agent and when you delete it.
settings.always_loaded_sub: Placed in this agent's instruction directory.
settings.always_loaded_hint: Read-only here. Edit the files themselves to change what the agent is told.
settings.always_loaded_unknown: The kernel did not answer about these files.
settings.left_out: Left out whole because it did not fit the shared budget: {{files}}.
settings.engine_hint: Chosen among the reasoning servers. CLI agents (Claude Code / Codex) appear here too.
settings.routing_sub: Optional. Send a turn to another engine when it matches.
settings.fallback_sub: Used when the last rule's engine refuses or fails
settings.fallback_hint: The kernel keeps a fallback per rule, for when that rule's engine answers with a rate limit or an error. This row edits the last rule's.
settings.memory_count: {{count}} long-term. What is in them is on the memory screen.
settings.memory_count_unknown: The memory server did not answer.
settings.avatar_sub: The face in the chat header and on the roster
settings.avatar_hint: Up to 5MB. If the VRM carries a thumbnail, it can be used instead.
settings.vrm_sub: The 3D model the avatar window shows
settings.colour_sub: The accent this agent wears on screen
settings.colour_hint: Used on their mark, on send, and on the edge of a question they ask.
settings.accent_invalid: Write a colour as hsl(H S% L%) — hue 0–360, the rest 0–100.
settings.tools_hint: Per server. “Default” follows that server's own policy; open a row to answer per tool.
settings.delete_sub: Its conversations and memories go too. This cannot be undone.
settings.default_protected: The agent that ships with ClotoCore cannot be deleted.
settings.unsaved_note: Nothing is applied until you save.
settings.routing_help: Conditions: contains:keyword, length:>N, tools_likely, default. Rules are tried in order and the first match wins.
